name: distinct_values
description: Return the distinct values of one property of a label (up to 50, most frequent first, with counts), optionally within a filter. Call it before filtering or grouping on a text property, to use values that really exist (exact spelling and case) - a filter on a value that does not exist silently returns nothing.

label.description: A label of the bank graph (see the data dictionary), e.g. Opportunity.

property.description: Property name, e.g. stage or lob.

filter.description: Optional: property to value (equality), or to a list of values.
